zh: 令 y[i] = X[i] − (i+1)，则 |X[i] − (k+i+1)| 就等于 |y[i] − k|，问题变成选一个 k 让到所有 y[i] 的距离之和最小。
一维上到若干点的绝对距离之和，在中位数处取到最小值，而且中位数本身是整数。
算出所有 y[i]（只差一个常数平移，用 X[i]−i 也可以），排序后取 y[n/2] 作为 k，累加 |y[i] − k| 输出；和可达 2×10¹⁴，用 64 位整数。
en: Let y[i] = X[i] − (i+1); then |X[i] − (k+i+1)| equals |y[i] − k|, so the task becomes choosing k to minimize the total distance to all y[i].
On a line, the sum of absolute distances to a set of points is minimized at a median, and the median is itself an integer.

Compute every y[i] (shifting all of them by the same constant, e.g. using X[i]−i, does not matter), sort, take k = y[n/2], and print the sum of |y[i] − k|; the sum reaches 2×10¹⁴, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let y[i] = X[i]−(i+1); the target becomes Σ|y[i]−k|, and the median of y is an optimal k.

## Proof of correctness

The sum of absolute deviations is minimized at the median. After the transformation the original expression equals |y[i]−k| term by term, so plugging in the median and summing gives the global minimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), extra space O(n).
